Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake:  
The first clear error was when WebSurfer clicked “NY Jidokwan Taekwondo” and ended up on an unrelated KEYENCE advertisement/product page instead of the martial arts school listing. That action derailed the search and caused the later irrelevant navigation loop. Because of this, the agent failed to gather the required address/schedule evidence and ultimately contributed to an unsupported final answer.
